ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (approx. 3%) to low-intensity pixels (approx. 97%); high-intensity pixels are predominantly localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region across central and proximal fluke areas; high-contrast white clusters mapped to the distal margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 45-55 degrees; bounding box depth approximately 15% of total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Regular high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 2 to 6 pixels at current resolution.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the central connection and tapering laterally to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (acorn barnacles) localized at the terminal distal points of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral tips of both lobes; sparse, small circular high-intensity spots distributed across the left lobe surface.
